## Information

This code calculates the total number of regionally elevated genes in the forebrain in the following:

* A Human
* A Pig
* A Mouse

:::{.callout-note}
The forebrain consists of the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus.
:::

## Data and calculations

In Human:
```{r}
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```
In Pig:
```{r}
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
In Mouse:
```{r}
sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
```
## Conclusion
The human was the species with the most regionally elevated expression in the data given.
